to.E3: 2,000 replicates x 70 cycles, burn_in 20 (50 post-burn-in cycles)

amendments.why: a chain smoke run (400 replicates x 30 cycles, cusum/gaussian, the full 26-rung ladder) measured 68 s; the declared sizes extrapolate to ~6 h of serial compute for E3 and ~17 h for E4, which was not budgeted. The reduced sizes keep the replicate-level SE of the chain ARL below ~0.5% and keep E4's delay-tail resolution at 6,000 replicates per arm.
amendments.when: BEFORE any E3 or E4 production artifact existed (only a SMOKE-tagged file, deleted)
what_did_NOT_change: the shift cycle (20, a re-baselining instant)
the preregistered tail floor of 200 events

smoke_run_observed.note: the smoke run reproduced P7's qualitative chain findings (ARL_0 non-monotone in rho with a grid maximum at rho ~ 0.25 = 3.7 x rho_c; ARL_0 at rho=1 of 51 (m=1) and 81 (m=5) against P7's reported 48-80). It fixed sizes only; no gate threshold was chosen or changed from it.

amendments.what: the PROCEDURE by which the P8 SR thresholds are found (not gate G2)
amendments.from: damped proportional iteration on 163,840-cycle evaluations, max 12 iterations, then one 1,024,000-cycle verification
amendments.to: the same search, followed by a refinement phase that evaluates at 614,400 cycles and applies the same proportional correction until the residual is inside 0.25%, then the same 1,024,000-cycle verification
amendments.why: the search-phase evaluations have a relative standard error of about 0.25%, which is not enough resolution to land inside G2's 0.5% tolerance reliably. The first pass left contam0.1 at 0.80% and t5 at 0.49%. The fix is to calibrate better, not to move the gate.
what_did_NOT_change: the frozen Gaussian SR threshold 520.886133602749, which is not recalibrated
every frozen Stage-D CUSUM threshold, which is never recalibrated
any scientific result: no P8 Gamma or chain cell had been run at an SR non-Gaussian threshold when this change was made
amendments.guard: experiments/finalize_sr_calibration.sh refuses to publish results/sr_calibration.json until every non-Gaussian family is inside the tolerance, so no downstream cell can be run on an out-of-tolerance threshold.
